plain_what: Flock picks earlier positions that look like the current one. Relation lets the model also follow simple links between positions, such as 'the word right after the earlier copy of this word', so it can learn the copy-the-next-word habit behind much of language. Each link type is switched on or off by one three-valued dial.
how_it_works: Relation is Flock plus a reranker. The pool is every causally eligible node of the ternary BinderPlan tree. Five edge types come from retained structure only: parent-child, sibling, sequential successor (leaf j+1 follows leaf j), same token id, same frame root. Each node starts with a match score 8 minus the L1 distance between its frame root and the query's frame root (8, 4 or 0). For S sweeps (1 to 5) each node adds, for every edge type e with a learned Gate trit g[e, level] in {-1,0,+1}, the previous scores of its neighbours: added if the trit is +1, subtracted if -1. Candidates are ranked by relation score first, then the Flock keys; the top K feed the unchanged Flock transport, consensus and gated add. Example: in 'x A B y z A', the earlier A scores 8; a +1 successor trit at level 0 passes that score to B, so B outranks every non-successor and its payload is carried in. That is the copy-successor read, which Route and Flock cannot express. With all trits zero every score is zero and the read is bit-identical to Flock. The trits reuse the Gate parameter kind (5 per level) and are proposed on an interleaved schedule where every 8th batch is a read batch.
geometry: Orbit-root frames of one 16-root E8 orbit (match score from L1 distance between frames); BFS transport; SpiralCore ternary BinderPlan tree whose parent/child/sibling/successor adjacency supplies the edges; ternary Gate trits.

rule_compat.D11: Integer only: compare, gather, add, subtract on i32 scores bounded by 472,392; trits are -1/0/+1; no multiply, no float. No D11 served export or export gap for a trained Relation artifact exists in the audited records.
rule_compat.D23: Compliant: hard top-K by integer keys, no exponential or normalisation.
rule_compat.D30: Compliant: no matmul; sweeps are sums over a bounded neighbour list (degree at most 8, 5 edge types).
rule_compat.D32_D37: D32 integer GPU path trained by counterfactual Gate moves; D34 authorises the reranker-first design as direction only (no compute or hold release); every run needs FIT, PM dispatch and an owner-typed D40 release. D37 allows a float-trained coupling extension only through a new pre-registration.

figure_ideas: The sequence 'x A B y z A' drawn as leaves of a small tree. Step 1: leaf A lights with match score 8. Step 2: a +1 successor trit sends a scored arrow one leaf to the right; B's score becomes 8 and it jumps to the top of the ranked list. A toggle sets all trits to zero and the ranking falls back to the Flock order.

A 5 x 5 grid (edge type by tree level) of ternary dials showing trit values; a slider replays training and shows which dials move off zero (94 accepted relation-trit updates in Dose 1, 87 in A8) and how P_succ admission changes beside it.

A funnel for the copy-successor target: 14,287 DEV rows, 8,648 where the query recurs, 3,847 where the target is the successor of its latest copy, then how many are admitted into the shortlist at checkpoint 0 (127, 1,351, 2,034 depending on codebook).
